subject: Game Theory
title: Hidden Actions
description: A fast breakdown of Hidden Actions for builders.

hook.text: You hire a contractor. You can't watch them every minute. Are they working hard or cutting corners?

buildup.text: Hidden action problems arise when one party's effort or behavior is unobservable to the other.

discovery.text: The solution: design contracts that align incentives. Commission-based pay rewards results, not effort.

twist.text: But incentive-based pay rewards gaming too. Teachers paid by test scores may teach to the test—or cheat.

climax.text: Goodhart's Law: any measure used as a target ceases to be a good measure. Incentives distort behavior.

punchline.text: If you can't observe effort, measure outcomes.

quiz.question: What is Goodhart's Law?
options: A measure used as a target stops being a good measure
